questions.q: Which role is primarily responsible for entering and matching supplier invoices?
questions.explain: The Accounts Payable (AP) specialist enters and matches supplier invoices and processes payments, inside the Payables module.

questions.q: Who typically owns the overall accuracy of a company's financial statements and the close process?
questions.explain: The Controller is accountable for the accuracy of the financial statements and the integrity of the close process, typically managing AP, AR, and GL teams.

questions.q: In most companies, who submits their own expense reports directly into the ERP?
questions.explain: Expense reports are typically self-service — every employee submits their own directly into the system.

questions.q: What is the primary role of an internal or external auditor in relation to the ERP?
options: They process day-to-day transactions like the AP team
They configure the system's security roles
They regularly review transactions and controls, such as the three-way match
questions.explain: Auditors don't process transactions themselves — they review them, which is why controls like the three-way match matter.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what is a functional consultant's day-to-day job, as opposed to the AP or AR team's job?
options: Configuring the system to support each role's process correctly, training users, and troubleshooting issues
Entering every invoice and payment personally
Only writing custom code for the system
questions.explain: A functional consultant configures Oracle Fusion to support these roles' processes, trains users, and troubleshoots problems — rather than performing the transactional work itself.
